serviceKeyPresets.name: Tracing only
serviceKeyPresets.use: Send OpenTelemetry traces and verify known trace IDs. Use this key on production application servers.

installSnippets.claudeCodeCli:
claude mcp add --transport http --scope user hue https://mcp.hue.run/mcp \
  --header 'Authorization: Bearer ${HUE_MCP_KEY}'
installSnippets.codexCli: codex mcp add hue --url https://mcp.hue.run/mcp --bearer-token-env-var HUE_MCP_KEY
installSnippets.geminiCli: gemini mcp add --transport http hue https://mcp.hue.run/mcp -H "Authorization: Bearer $HUE_MCP_KEY"
installSnippets.verifyPrompt: Use the Hue MCP: call get_project_context, then show my 5 most recent error traces with links.
